comment_regular: Oblivion sneak-attack decision. Creatures are excluded as attackers; the attacker must be sneaking; victim detection <= 0 permits the bonus unless combat-awareness logic forces failure. Successful attacks use the attacker's Sneak mastery plus weapon type to select the multiplier, set the Master-tier flag when applicable, show the player message, and pass the multiplier into damage calculation.
